mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbox_event ( event_id, consumer_name, status, received_at, processed_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{consumerName}, 'PROCESSING', #{receivedAt}, NULL, NULL, #{receivedAt}, #{receivedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (event_id, consumer_name) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO inbox_event ( event_id, consumer_name, status, received_at, processed_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{consumerName}, 'PROCESSING', #{now}, NULL, NULL, #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (event_id, consumer_name) DO UPDATE SET status = 'PROCESSING', received_at = #{now}, processed_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE inbox_event.status = 'FAILED' OR ( inbox_event.status = 'PROCESSING' AND inbox_event.updated_at <= NOW() - (#{processingTimeoutMs} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') )
